Enfoco cada proyecto buscando un código modular, buscando la reutilización de varios componentes aislados. en: In my seven years of experience, I've developed various games in Unity and completed the Master's in Video Game Development and Programming at the UOC. I approach each project with modular code, seeking to reuse several isolated components. I've created numerous robust and optimized Unity Packages, designed to be integrated and leveraged across multiple projects
cat: En 7 anys d'experiència he desenvolupat diversos jocs fets a Unity i cursat el Màster en Desenvolupament i Programació de Videojocs a la UOC.
